collection.description: Trial 1 is the retained primary report from a successful --repeat-each=3 invocation. Trials 2 and 3 were separate successful one-run invocations with unique --output directories. Each trial executed WebGL, native standard WebGPU, and native material-aware WebGPU over the same 13 states.
